instruction.text: Complete the sentence by writing the correct spelling of the word in the gap.

atoms.b: Look ((through)) lost property for your hat.
atoms.finishSound: Look through lost property for your hat.

atoms.b: The ((purpose)) of the advert is to sell more things.
atoms.finishSound: The purpose of the advert is to sell more things.

atoms.b: ((Although)) he’s on a diet, he had some chocolate.
atoms.finishSound: Although he’s on a diet, he had some chocolate.

atoms.b: I’m a ((quarter)) of the way through my book.
atoms.finishSound: I’m a quarter of the way through my book.

atoms.b: You should go to bed at a ((regular)) time.
atoms.finishSound: You should go to bed at a regular time.

atoms.b: They went somewhere ((special)) for their date.
atoms.finishSound: They went somewhere special for their date.

atoms.b: ((Consider)) your words before you say them.
atoms.finishSound: Consider your words before you say them.
